items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: other than the lady that portrayed Harriet Tubman

ctx.x: Yeah, because they could have always dubbed the voice.

Sure, they could have got an actress like -- I think Abbie would have been my choice to do it, period, you know. I think she would have -- and she was -- Carmen would have done a good job because Carmen and Billie Holiday were good buddies. They were good friends. Someone that knew Billie Holiday, I think would have done a better job, you know, because every time somebody portrays one of our heroes, other than the lady that portrayed Harriet Tubman -- what's her name?
